title: Pure Unchained
summary: Unchained cards only, with generic Fiend Links and staples. The Unchained destroy their own cards on purpose. The Twins (Aruha, Rakea, Sarama) each summon another Unchained from the hand or Deck when destroyed. Every Set Unchained Spell/Trap summons an Unchained from the Deck when it is destroyed. Abomination's Prison searches any Unchained card. Unchained Soul of Rage and Anguish Link Summon using one of the opponent's monsters as material, which removes it. The 2023 cards lead. Unchained Soul of Sharvara summons itself from the hand by destroying your card and Sets an Unchained Spell/Trap from the Deck when it is sent to the GY. Shyama clears a Spell/Trap, and Unchained Soul Lord of Yama searches an Unchained. Sharvara is Semi-Limited. The newer OCG-only Unchained cards stay out. The Twins limit you to Fiends for the turn.
